b. Export the images using Batch Exporter.
Steps: select the batch containing the set of sample images.
Configure Batch Exporter to select an export directory.
Tools / start / batch exporter (send the sample images as a zip file.)
c. Capture error logs:
- Enable logging in Capture Manager 5.2.1.
- Select verbose option to log all errors.
- Write to an output log and send log file to support for further review.

d. Verify if problem is reproducible running different scenarios.
- importing the same images on a batch manually.
- running Doc Processing in a capture path. 
- DocProcessing the batch in Local Repository using default settings and template.

Ø Schedule the committing of batches at the end of the day, or during off peak hours.
